title: commelina erecta var. obliqua
intro: Commelina erecta var. obliqua, commonly known as whorled dayflower, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its use in treating various health conditions. The health benefits of Commelina erecta var. obliqua include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for these therapeutic actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
